summary: A native channel can bind while its PTY title is renamed without falsely treating the live runtime as replaced.

replay.detail: No claim replay, history rewrite or projection rebuild. The change affects live local channel custody validation.

schema.detail: No stored format, database or claim schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, replication rule or rules-version changes.

compatibility.detail: Local channel revalidation tolerates changes to the PTY presentation label. Exact runtime name, PID, creation stamp, running status, exit code, all tags, daemon process identity and peer ancestry checks remain enforced. No client or PTY protocol changes or coordinated upgrades are required; older daemons retain the false-refusal race.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption or seat restart is required by this change.

manual.detail: No migration, configuration or manual action is required.

recovery.detail: The change persists no new state. Reverting restores the earlier title-rename refusal behavior without a data recovery step.
